name: io.github.docker/hub-mcp
title: Docker Hub MCP Server
description: MCP server that connects LLMs to Docker Hub for image search, repository, and tag management

packageArguments.name: --username
packageArguments.description: Docker Hub username associated with HUB_PAT_TOKEN, used for authenticated requests.

environmentVariables.name: HUB_PAT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Docker Hub Personal Access Token. Required to manage repositories; omit for read-only access to public content.
